{{Top|leg}}
'''Sedri''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sedrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was punctuated by the occasional bark or whistle, and including combinations of grunts and barks. At times. Sedri was truly beautiful and sounded almost like a song. Pidgin Sedri was understood by other [[Species/Legends|species]] such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. The Sedrian language included many idioms, with the sayings built on the marine lifestyle of the Sedrians.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
